observation: The universal worker model must not expose 'no ordinary task available' as a convenient stop choice. A fungible shell should traverse the existing useful-work metabolism before TURN_COMPLETE. Human launches capacity; Prometeo routes it. Absence of primary execution work is only a branch condition, not a terminal state.

existing_capabilities.coliseo_semantics: worker returns to pool or disappears only after finite burst; liveness derives from real events

current_gap: worker-prompts/current.txt currently permits bounded grace -> TURN_COMPLETE after the explicit primary/reserve lanes. METABOLISM_POLICY_V1 is stronger: stop only when all safe useful execution/recovery/guide/discovery work is exhausted. The integration gap is activation/order, not a need for a new scheduler.

corrected_semantics.bad: NO_WORK -> worker chooses whether to stop
corrected_semantics.good: NO_PRIMARY_WORK -> traverse grounded fallback ladder -> TURN_COMPLETE only with exhaustion evidence

fallback_ladder: replenish grounded frontier via GUIDE_PLANNER when target pressure says useful
repair repeated collisions/blockers/human-routing friction via GUIDE_RESCATE
attack unverified new mechanisms via GUIDE_CRITIC
consume delegated system/observability/discovery work with an explicit consumer
TURN_COMPLETE only after safe useful lanes are exhausted
important_non_goal: Never fabricate filler/busywork merely to keep a worker alive. The correct invariant is useful-work exhaustion, not immortality.
recovered_design_boundary: The user's earlier Coliseo concept included spare capacity doing system-facing work such as keeping human-visible status/Guide output current and potentially voice/TTS. Current repository evidence proves Guide metabolism and separate Coliseo/TTS capabilities, but this review did not find a canonical owner proving a generic idle->TTS fallback. Treat that exact mapping as RECOVER/VERIFY before activation, not as current authority.
visual_flow_candidate: ENTER -> primary work? -> execute -> RETURN -> cycle; else integration? -> integrate; else frontier pressure? -> plan; else friction? -> rescate; else weak mechanism? -> critic; else grounded system/discovery work? -> execute; else bounded reload -> exhaustion proof -> TURN_COMPLETE.
experiment_rule: The human should use one universal /wc prompt. Experiment/project containment lives in allocator/packet state, never in the human prompt.
